purpose: Decide whether weighting dense retrieval above BM25 in the main app's RRF fusion finds multi-hop evidence better than the current 1:1 fusion, with the weight chosen on one sample and judged on another it never saw.
method: services.vectorstore.hybrid_query_document with HYBRID_DENSE_WEIGHT / HYBRID_BM25_WEIGHT, rerank disabled, BAAI/bge-m3 embeddings, corpus indexed as in musique_multihop_v1 (one paragraph per chunk, title + text).

tuning.sample: evaluation/musique_multihop (musique_multihop_v1), already used for the GraphRAG comparison.
tuning.selection: The weight with the highest full_support@10; ties broken by recall@10, then by the weight closest to 1:1. 1:1 itself may win, which means no change.

holdout.sample: This directory: 100 questions drawn with seed 20260926, stratified 40/30/30 by hops, disjoint from the tuning sample, pooled into their own corpus.
holdout.comparison: Selected weight versus 1:1 on the held-out sample only.
holdout.primary_endpoint: recall@10, paired bootstrap 95% interval (10000 resamples, seed 20260925).
holdout.secondary: full_support@10 by exact McNemar; recall@5 and recall@20 descriptive. Every weight is reported descriptively on the held-out sample, but only the selected one is compared.

decision_rule.candidate: The primary interval's lower bound > 0: the selected weight becomes a candidate default for English-like material.
decision_rule.default_is_not_changed_here: Chinese material, where exact term matching may matter more, has not been measured; a candidate becomes the default only after a Chinese check.

not_measured: Answer quality: retrieval only, no model answers.
Interaction with the optional reranker, query rewriting or HyDE.
